messages:
maria_support: Incoming escalation from Acme (FR). They report spikes of ~800ms and intermittent 401s since 06:00 CET. Customer says traffic is landing in us-east instead of eu-central. sample req-id: req_5f9c2a3
acme_oncall: confirmed. We saw many retries from our side, token errors show mismatch: token region claim = eu-central but auth request seen at us-east. Billing spike from retries noticed.
devon_sre: pinging. any dig / traceroute from their customer available? if DNS resolution is returning us IPs that's the first clue.
maria_support: pasted headers+ip from their logs:
```
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Req-Id: req_5f9c2a3
Authorization: Bearer <redacted> (iss: redwood, region: eu-central)
Client-IP: 185.62.34.11
```
jessica_eng: thanks. can you ask for the resolved A record and TTL? run `dig +short @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.ai` and `dig +trace api.redwood.ai` from their network. also `curl -v` to capture TLS SNI.
acme_oncall: ran `dig` at 06:03 CET -> `35.193.120.10` (us-east block) TTL 300. trace shows NS replies pointing to our edge with old geoip mapping.
devon_sre: hmm. we pushed a GeoIP DB refresh yesterday at 02:00 but one of the edge caches (edge-ams-02) appears to have missed replication. that would cause the local resolver to map FR -> us-east.
ops_bot: geoip-sync job started: job_id=gj_20240214_0202. status=COMPLETED on control-plane nodes. pending on edge-ams-02 (last sync attempt: 1718460000, status=FAILED).
jessica_eng: that explains the wrong POP selection and 401s — token routing decision is region-aware. If request lands in us-east our auth layer rejects tokens scoped to eu region. retries then cause billing and latency.
maria_support: immediate mitigation suggestions for Acme: 1) temporarily set `region=eu-central` in SDK config (client-side pin) 2) flush local DNS cache / reduce resolver TTL 3) we will force sync the geoip cache on our side. asking them to hold until we confirm.
devon_sre: running forced sync on edge-ams-02 now: `sudo /opt/geoip/sync.sh --force --edge edge-ams-02`
ops_bot: geoip-sync forced: task=gj_force_171850. edge-ams-02: sync started.
(10m later)
ops_bot: geoip-sync completed on edge-ams-02. new db version v2026_02_14.
devon_sre: after sync, I see edges returning eu addresses for sample IPs. Can @acme_oncall re-run `dig` and curl tests?
acme_oncall: re-run at 06:18 CET -> `35.195.11.22` (eu-central pool), TTL 58. curl shows requests landing in eu-central, 200 responses, auth OK. latency back to ~60ms.
jessica_eng: (typo fix) jessica_eng: noted recovery. we'll monitor for 2 hours.
maria_support: I told Acme to expect a small billing credit for retry-backfill; will reconcile after we pull counts. pls flag if >3 customers hit.
devon_sre: root cause: replication failure of geoip DB to edge-ams-02 caused stale mapping -> wrong-pop answers -> auth token region mismatch -> client retries -> billing/latency spike. action items: 1) postmortem if >3 customers affected 2) add alert for edge geoip-sync failures 3) reduce critical TTLs or expose a forced invalidation API.
jessica_eng: I'll open infra ticket with runbook to auto-force sync on failure + add metric to PagerDuty.
maria_support: I'll follow up with Acme with timeline and credits. closing thread when billing reconcile confirmed. :white_check_mark:
